payload.summary: The council's consultation page for the licensing policy review, open from 18 May to 9 August 2026 on its Get Talking Norwich site. It explains in plain terms what the policy covers — alcohol sales, live music, theatre and film, and hot food sold after 11pm — and that the law requires a review at least every five years. It promises that all responses will be analysed and summarised in a report to the Licensing committee in September 2026, with the final policy approved by full council. The survey is now closed and the page records 67 responses; the responses themselves are not published on it.
